findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "get_calibration" is 2724 chars, far longer than this server's median (321). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

evidence.snippet: The calibration record: Brier skill by question family for the pastcast pool and the live track, with the launch-gate verdict for the horizon asked for. horizon…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: dependency_risk · Private data: get_entity, get_calibration, dependency_risk · Public sink: get_calibration · Destructive: get_calibration.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: dependency_risk · Private data: get_entity, get_calibration, dependency_risk · Public sink: get_calibration · Destructive: get_calibration

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_calibration" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
